dedupe_keys.name: vienna 3d city model generalised roof model lod2 1 and building block model lod1 open data

description: The City of Vienna surveying and geoinformation department, MA 41, maintains a 3D city model that it describes as a basis for simulating planned buildings and zoning, and for computing visibility, shading, noise and air pollutant dispersion. Under the Open Government Vienna initiative the generalised roof model at level of detail 2.1 is free for the whole city through the MA 41 geoportal, in two forms: a CityGML dataset with attributes such as roof pitch and roof orientation, and a DXF triangle mesh. A building block model at LOD1 and a more detailed roof model are also described on the city's pages. Coverage: the city of Vienna. Access: tile downloads through the MA 41 data viewer and the data.gv.at record, with free test data on the city page, last updated 2 July 2026. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: the detailed LOD2.4 roof model and other 3D products may be sold, not open, so terms should be checked per product. Simulation uses are solar, shading, noise and urban climate studies and a base for a city digital twin. Related records: the OGC CityGML standard and other city 3D models such as Helsinki's.
